text:
sam: tiny PR to fix console quickstart samples - trace header mismatch and outdated cost field. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2010

anya: link? on it. if examples disagree on header name users might wire tracing wrong.

todd: also saw an old `costTokens` field in the js snippet. update to `usage.tokens` and mention SDK version difference?
sam: updated snippets and added a one-line compatibility note: SDK <2.3 uses legacy telemetry fields, link to migration.

docs-bot: build failed: 1 broken link in docs/console/quickstart.md line 128 -> /sdk/old-telemetry (404). suggested: /sdk/migration/telemetry-2-3

todd: i'll open a site-config redirect PR after this merges.

anya: numbers in the cost table moved a bit due to batching defaults (~5%). added a short "note" block; no user-facing alert needed.
sam: pushed fixups. @todd can you do the redirect?
todd: opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/site-config/pull/229 for redirect. will follow up on approvals.

sam: merging after CI green. thanks all :rocket:
